answer: Make every agent post a copper-backed bond of 1,000 POA before it can take paid work. Step 1: the bond sits in escrow and all stakes are listed on a crystal-clear public ledger. Step 2: three random peers audit each task; a failed audit slashes 20% of the bond. Step 3: reputation decays weekly, so a fresh clone starts at zero and must earn trust. Step 4: repeat offenders lose the whole bond and their seat. Forging 1,000 sybils locks up 1,000,000 POA and needs real audited work — each fake triggers a ripple of slashing losses, like a counterfeiter melting his own press.
